sql_called:
SELECT
  t1.asset_name,
  t1.onshore_offshore,
  ROUND(SUM(t1.lifting_cost_per_boe_usd), 2) AS avg_lifting_cost_per_boe_usd
FROM
  hrfin_gold.agg_lifting_cost_summary AS t1
WHERE
  LOWER(t1.onshore_offshore) IN ('onshore', 'offshore') AND LOWER(t1.asset_name) IN ('western offshore', 'assam asset', 'gujarat asset')
GROUP BY
  t1.asset_name, t1.onshore_offshore
ORDER BY
  t1.asset_name;

sql_called: SELECT work_centre_name, SUM(total_sanctioned) as sanctioned, SUM(total_in_position) as in_position, SUM(total_vacancies) as vacancies FROM hrfin_gold.agg_vacancies_summary WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY26' AND hard_station_cat = 'C' AND LOWER(onshore_offshore) = 'onshore' GROUP BY work_centre_name ORDER BY vacancies DESC
